title: About InternSphere
content: InternSphere is an AI-Powered Internship Matching & Career Assistant platform designed to streamline the internship application process. It features automated resume parsing, semantic vector-based internship matching, skill gap analysis, grounded AI cover letter generation with Gemini, end-to-end application lifecycle tracking, and an interactive RAG-powered career product assistant.

title: Internship Matching & Semantic Search
content: InternSphere combines the authenticated candidate's saved profile with their latest parsed resume data. The system extracts technical skills, education, work experience, and projects into a rich candidate context vector. It then performs semantic similarity search across the vectorized internship dataset using cosine similarity. The overall match score is calculated using a transparent multi-factor formula: 45% semantic similarity + 45% skill match percentage + 10% preferred skills bonus, capped at 100%.

title: Match Percentage Meaning
content: The overall match percentage indicates how strongly a candidate's background aligns with an internship. It is composed of two primary sub-metrics: 'Semantic Match' (contextual similarity between candidate experience/projects and the job description) and 'Skill Match' (the percentage of required and preferred skills possessed by the candidate). A score above 80% represents an excellent alignment, 60-80% indicates good qualification with minor gaps, and below 60% highlights key skills to develop.

title: Skill Gap Analysis
content: Skill Gap Analysis compares the candidate's structured skills (from both manual profile entries and parsed resumes) against the required and preferred skills of each internship. The system normalizes equivalent skill names (e.g., 'JS' to 'JavaScript', 'Postgres' to 'PostgreSQL', 'React.js' to 'React') while preserving the employer's original listing. It categorizes skills into Matched Skills (✓), Missing Required Skills (✗), and Missing Preferred Skills, giving actionable feedback on what skills to acquire.

title: Resume Upload & Dynamic Parsing
content: Users can upload resumes in PDF and DOCX formats up to 5 MB. InternSphere uses a hybrid extraction pipeline: text extraction via pdfplumber for PDFs and python-docx for DOCX files, deterministic regex extraction for reliable contact details (email, phone, LinkedIn, GitHub), and Google Gemini LLM extraction for deep contextual parsing of professional summary, technical skills, soft skills, work experience, projects, education, certifications, and achievements. Parsing is dynamic for any candidate document and produces clean visual cards without raw JSON.

title: Profile Management & Photo Upload
content: Each user owns a private profile containing personal details (full name, email, phone, location), education (university, degree, branch, graduation year, CGPA), professional summary, technical and soft skills, projects, certifications, achievements, and social links (LinkedIn, GitHub, Portfolio). Users can upload a high-resolution profile picture, view an instant preview, change the photo, or remove it. Profile data is securely persisted in the database and automatically merged with uploaded resume data during internship matching.

title: Cover Letter Generation & Document Editor
content: InternSphere generates tailored, professional cover letters using Google Gemini. The generation prompt is strictly grounded: it uses only facts from the candidate's profile/resume and the target internship description, prohibiting fabrication of experiences, skills, or employers. Once generated, the letter appears in a large, document-style editor (550px+ height) where users can edit, save, regenerate, copy to clipboard, or download as a clean plain text (.txt) or formatted PDF (.pdf) file. Cover letter downloads are completely isolated from profile images.

title: Application System & Status Tracking
content: Candidates can apply directly to eligible internships from the Matches or Internships pages. When applying, a persistent application record is created linking the user, internship, resume, and optional cover letter with an initial status of 'Applied'. Applications can progress through 'Under Review', 'Interview', 'Selected', 'Rejected', or 'Withdrawn'. Candidates can track their application history, view attached materials, and withdraw applications with a confirmation prompt, updating the database record permanently.

title: AI Assistant & Session Isolation
content: The InternSphere AI Assistant is a dedicated product knowledge assistant. Each new chat creates a unique session with a distinct session ID in the database and starts completely empty. Previous session history is stored separately in the database and accessible via the Recent Chats sidebar. The assistant maintains memory of the current active session (e.g., accurately answering 'What was my previous question?'). For questions outside the scope of InternSphere (e.g., trivia, general knowledge, poetry), it provides a polite, concise response and redirects the user to InternSphere career features.

title: RAG Architecture & Embeddings
content: InternSphere implements Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The system chunks and indexes both the internship catalog and product knowledge base into vector embeddings. Search queries are converted into dense vector representations and ranked against indexed chunks using cosine similarity. The top relevant chunks are injected as verified context into the Gemini prompt, ensuring that generated answers and recommendations are factually accurate, hallucination-free, and grounded in current platform data.
